americanoperator-americanoperator:ashbyh.title: Deal Sourcing Analyst
americanoperator-americanoperator:ashbyh.description: American Operator is seeking a driven, high-energy Deal Sourcing Analyst to generate proprietary acquisition opportunities. This role sits at the very start of the deal process, focused on building relationships with business owners and sourcing off-market opportunities. If you thrive in high-volume, results-driven environments, enjoy outbound prospecting, and want to build a career in private equity, investing, or M&A, this role is for you. This role is based at our Austin, TX office. RESPONSIBILITIES - Proactively research and reach out to target business owners via cold calls, emails, LinkedIn, SMS, and other channels to generate off-market deal flow. - Lead early conversations with business owners, clearly explaining who we are, the types of businesses we partner with, and why owners choose to work with us. - Conduct initial discovery meetings to gather baseline information, evaluate fit, and determine next steps for each opportunity. - Maintain and update our CRM with all outreach activity, prospect information, and follow-ups to keep deals moving forward. - Work closely with the Investments team to hand off qualified opportunities and continue nurturing owner relationships. - Consistently follow up with prospects over time, building trust and rapport to maintain a healthy pipeline. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS - 1+ years of experience in sales, business development, or deal sourcing (cold calling experience highly preferred). - Comfortable and confident making high-volume outbound calls. - Strong communication and relationship-building skills. - Self-starter with the ability to manage multiple prospects simultaneously. - Experience with CRMs (Hubspot or similar) and tracking outreach activity. - Interest in private equity, investing, or M&A, and willingness to learn financial basics. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Undergraduate degree in business, finance, or related field. - Exposure to small business operations (family business, internships, etc.). - Familiarity with basic financial statements (P&L, balance sheet, tax returns) is a plus. Compensation: This role offers substantial performance-based upside. We pay 50 bps per acquisition, which equates to ~$25,000 (per closed deal). At 6-12 deals per year, that equates to $150,000–$300,000+ in total compensation for strong performers. Bonus payouts are tied to individual performance metrics and closed transactions and are subject to plan terms and company performance. ABOUT THE TEAM American Operator exists because we believe the American Dream is worth protecting, and that small businesses are the backbone of our communities. To do this well, we need a team that reflects the real world: operators, builders, investors, and problem-solvers from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences. We know that diversity of thought, discipline, and lived experience leads to better decisions and stronger businesses. We’re intentional about bringing together people who care deeply about ownership, stewardship, and keeping great companies in capable hands. Our work depends on collaboration, humility, and a shared belief in the value of Main Street. We’re a team shaped by different industries, hometowns, and career paths, and we believe those differences are exactly what prepare us to serve small-business owners and future CEOs across the country. MISSION-DRIVEN Every company claims to be mission-driven, but our mission is simple, tangible, and urgent: preserve the legacy of America’s small businesses and create more pathways to meaningful ownership. We partner with operators who want to step into leadership, take responsibility for great companies, and continue the work that founders spent decades building. When we succeed, communities keep their employers, families keep their livelihoods, and operators get the chance to build wealth through real ownership. We work hard because we know what’s at stake: generational businesses that deserve to thrive, and talented operators who deserve the chance

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:6111e8fb-abf.title: Client Success Manager
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:6111e8fb-abf.description: About the Role: We are seeking a Client Relations Coach to develop, support, and elevate the performance of our Customer Success Managers (CSMs). This role combines coaching, quality assurance, and training delivery to ensure our CSMs are equipped to drive long-term client success. The ideal candidate has prior experience coaching CSMs or similar client-facing roles and brings a structured approach to performance improvement. Former BPO trainers with a strong QA background are welcome to apply.
responsibilities: Coach and mentor Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to improve customer satisfaction, retention, and relationship management
Conduct quality reviews on customer interactions (calls, emails, task updates) and provide detailed feedback
Develop and deliver coaching plans tailored to individual performance metrics and team goals
Collaborate with leadership on team skill development, training needs, and continuous improvement
Lead training sessions and skill refreshers to reinforce best practices and performance standards
Maintain standardized coaching documentation and feedback tools
Track, report, and analyze coaching effectiveness and performance trends
qualifications: Experience coaching Customer Success Managers, Account Managers, or similar roles
Solid foundation in quality assurance and structured feedback delivery
Former BPO trainers with QA and client-facing experience are strongly encouraged to apply
Excellent communication, facilitation, and coaching skills
Familiarity with CRMs and performance coaching tools
Must be able to work in a hybrid setup and align with a US time zone (night shift) schedule
Must present original coaching/training materials during the hiring process
Conduct a mock training simulation (live)
Present a self-made presentation deck on the following topics:
“What is a Customer Success Manager?”
“How to Be a Successful CSM”
This simulation will be used to assess facilitation skills, structure, clarity, and relevance of content.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:686b2f68-4259-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Operations, Data Science based in Italy. This is a senior, cross-functional role connecting business strategy, data science, technology, and client delivery. You will help turn complex data and analytical capabilities into practical solutions that improve business performance. The role combines operational leadership with product-oriented thinking and hands-on Agile development management. You will coordinate high-impact data science workstreams across strategy, growth, finance, technology, and other teams. You will also support client engagements, workshops, and business development opportunities by translating technical insights into clear business value. The environment is collaborative and fast-moving, bringing together technologists, data scientists, creators, and subject-matter experts. This is an opportunity to shape how data, intelligence, and AI-enabled capabilities are applied to solve meaningful business challenges. Lead business optimization strategy: Act as a key liaison between business stakeholders and the Data Science team, helping identify opportunities where data and analytics can address organizational priorities and improve outcomes. Coordinate cross-functional initiatives: Facilitate collaboration across Growth, Strategy, Enablement, Finance, technology, product, and other business functions to ensure data science priorities align with broader organizational and technology roadmaps. Manage Agile delivery: Work with senior data science leadership to identify and prioritize high-impact initiatives, translate business requirements into technical direction, and manage epics, backlogs, sprint planning, grooming, reviews, and ongoing delivery. Support data science projects: Partner with opportunity owners and project leads to develop data-driven solutions for selected clients, helping move initiatives from business requirements through execution and delivery. Facilitate client engagement: Participate in in-person client workshops, requirements-gathering sessions, results presentations, and business development meetings, helping connect technical capabilities with client needs. Translate data into business insights: Turn complex datasets, analytical outputs, and technical concepts into clear, compelling recommendations that can be understood and acted upon by executives, clients, and cross-functional teams. Coordinate with technical teams: Work closely with data science, agency technology, product, and other technical stakeholders to ensure priorities, dependencies, and delivery plans remain aligned. Support data-driven tools and reporting: Help guide the development and use of dashboards, analytics solutions, and intelligence tools that enable better business decisions. Drive operational excellence: Establish effective processes for prioritization, communication, delivery tracking, and continuous improvement across data science workstreams. Requirements: Strategic and product-oriented experience: Demonstrated experience connecting business priorities with technical or data-driven solutions, ideally with a background in product ownership, operations, strategy, or data science program management. Data science exposure: Strong understanding of how data science teams operate and how analytical capabilities can be translated into practical business solutions. Agile delivery management: Experience managing Agile development processes, including epic planning, backlog prioritization, sprint planning, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, and delivery coordination. Cross-functional leadership: Ability to facilitate conversations and align stakeholders across business, technology, data, finance, strategy, and other functions. Client-facing capability: Comfortable participating in client workshops, requirements sessions, presentations, and business development discussions. Communication

jobgether-jobgether:lever:a9f95908-1b16-.title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer - Imunify Reliability Platform
jobgether-jobgether:lever:a9f95908-1b16-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Site Reliability Engineer - Imunify Reliability Platform based in Australia. This is a greenfield SRE leadership opportunity within a large-scale, security-focused product environment. You will define what “healthy” means across roughly 70 components spanning cloud services and customer-hosted agents. You will establish SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, monitoring standards, alerting, and escalation practices from the ground up. Your work will directly improve the ability to detect silent security-control degradation before it becomes a widespread customer-impacting issue. You will collaborate closely with engineering leads and senior engineers while building the telemetry and reliability platform yourself. The environment is remote-first, async, technically demanding, and focused on measurable outcomes rather than dashboards for their own sake. This is an opportunity to shape the reliability culture and foundations of a major security product. Define and establish meaningful SLIs for approximately 70 product components, working with squad leads and senior engineers to agree on ownership, measurement, tiering, SLOs, and error budgets. Develop a reliability taxonomy covering service availability and latency, fleet reachability and configuration convergence, security-control efficacy, artifact delivery, and telemetry pipeline health. Ensure reliability indicators are independently measurable and cannot be disabled by the same failure they are intended to detect. Design and build the telemetry collection pipeline for customer-hosted agents and cloud services, balancing push-based collection, sampling, privacy constraints, data quality, and cardinality. Extend instrumentation across Python, Go, and Rust components in collaboration with product engineering teams. Consolidate existing dashboards, queries, and reporting mechanisms into a smaller, more reliable observability platform, retiring tooling that does not provide meaningful operational value. Implement symptom-based, SLO-driven alerting with multi-window burn-rate principles and clear page, ticket, and dashboard classifications. Ensure every production alert has a defined owner, documented failure mode, and actionable runbook. Establish ongoing alert-quality practices, including periodic reviews, measurable actionable-alert rates, and deliberate removal of unnecessary alerts. Build a machine-readable ownership and escalation model that routes incidents to the appropriate engineering squads. Establish severity definitions, acknowledgement expectations, follow-the-sun escalation practices, and clean handoff procedures across multiple time zones. Strengthen incident command and blameless postmortem practices, including reliable timelines, ownership, and follow-through on corrective actions. Coach engineering squads to own their own operational responsibilities and paging rather than becoming a centralized buffer for other teams' alerts. Deliver measurable reliability outcomes over the first year, including complete SLI ownership, production telemetry, tiered alerting, squad on-call adoption, and a significant reduction in the time required to detect silent security-control degradation. Requirements Substantial production engineering or SRE experience, including experience defining and implementing an SLO framework rather than simply operating within an existing one. Strong Python skills and the ability to read and modify Go or Rust code when implementing instrumentation and reliability improvements. Strong hands-on experience with time-series and event telemetry at scale, including Prometheus/OpenMetrics, Grafana, Alertmanager-class routing systems, and columnar or high-cardinality data stores such as ClickHouse or equivalent technologies. By unifying Digital Risk Protection, Human Risk Management and Email Security, Doppel connects threats into a real-time intelligence graph to power faster disruption, smarter defense, and modern security awareness at scale. Backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer Venture Partners, and trusted by leading enterprises, Doppel is a rapidly growing Series C startup building the future of social engineering defense. Our team combines deep cybersecurity expertise, operational rigor, and startup velocity to solve some of the internet’s most urgent trust and safety challenges. We crossed 6 figures within a few months of launching and are on track to hit 1M ARR in Q4. Our mission: to help companies proactively defend against the next wave of social-engineering attacks. You’ll be joining a team led by ex-Meta and YC founders, already working with Fortune 100 customers. For example: - Build out a “Cursor for phishing simulation” flow that lets users create simulations using natural language.. - Build out voice deepfakes that use AI to call employees pretending to be their co-worker. This partnership empowers Spokane Urology to deliver superior, individualized patient care by leveraging Urology Alliance’s robust, world-class business and organizational support, ensuring our clinicians can focus on what they do best – providing top-notch care in a successful and dynamic private practice setting.
